clauses.title: Glass
clauses.text: Glass, windshield, windows, and mirrors are covered.

clauses.title: Factory structural components
clauses.text: Factory structural components are covered, including panels, frame rails, and body structure.

clauses.title: Collision damage to factory components
clauses.text: Collision damage to factory components is covered.

clauses.title: Factory safety systems
clauses.text: Factory safety systems are covered, including airbags and their sensors.

clauses.title: Aftermarket modifications
clauses.text: Aftermarket modifications and non-factory parts are excluded from coverage, including aftermarket bumpers, spoilers, light bars, and exhaust components.

clauses.title: Pre-existing damage
clauses.text: Damage present before this incident or before the policy's coverage period is excluded. Evidence such as rust, oxidized paint edges, or weathering around damage indicates a pre-existing condition.

clauses.title: Mechanical wear and tear
clauses.text: Mechanical wear and tear from normal use over time, not caused by a specific incident, is excluded. This includes worn suspension bushings, leaking seals from age, and similar gradual failures.
